card.name: Digits inside DOI and ISSN numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a long reference number, such as a DOI or ISSN in a citation. It is weaker on digits inside other numbers, such as patient counts.

modes.label: Digits in reference codes
modes.description: A digit partway through a DOI or ISSN string in a citation.

modes.label: Digit inside a larger number
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a multi-digit count in running text.

card.plain: It marks the middle digits of long citation codes like DOI and ISSN numbers.
